statement.p: 11 ladies of a certain age drop off their red hats at the hat check of a museum. As they are leaving, the hat check attendant gives the hats back randomly. In how many ways can exactly 6 of the ladies receive their own hat (and the other 5 not)?

solution.p: {11 \choose 6}\left(5! - \left[{5 \choose 1} 4! - {5 \choose 2}3! \dots + {5 \choose 5}0! \right]\right)={20328} ways. We choose 6 of the 11 ladies to get their own hats, and then multiply by the number of ways the remaining hats can be deranged.
